Projekt Pfotenglück: die Datenbank plane: Project Pfotenglück: planning the database · SQL course
Pfotenglück – du planst deine eigene Dat: Pfotenglück – you plan your own database
Bisher hast du Datenbanken befragt, die: So far you have queried databases that other people built. From today on you build one yourself. Every database project starts with a plan: which tables? Which columns? How are they connected? A mistake in the plan costs a lot of work later – good planning saves it.
Vorher überlegen, wie etwas aufgebaut wi: To think beforehand about how something will be built.
Der Plan einer Datenbank: Tabellen, Spal: The plan of a database: tables, columns, relationships.
Die Zeichnung des Datenmodells: Kästen u: The drawing of the data model: boxes and lines.
Eine Plattform, auf der man jemanden ken: A platform where you can meet someone – here: for pets.
Die Firmenleitung von Pfotenglück beauft: The management of Pfotenglück gives you a job: build a matchmaking site for pets. Owners register their pets, each pet has a profile (hobby, favourite food, quirk, who it is looking for) – and you should be able to find matching partners.
Dein Weg: heute planen (Lektion 12) · Ta: Your path: plan today (lesson 12) · create and fill tables (13) · change and test (14) · build forms (15 and 16). Work alone or in pairs.

Die Firmenleitung will speichern, welche: The management wants to store which animal likes which. An animal likes many, and many like it. A match is when two animals like each other. Add a table likes to your plan with two foreign keys (von_tier_id and an_tier_id) that both point to tiere.
Ein Besitzer hat viele Tiere. Wo steht d: An owner has many animals. Where is the foreign key?
Ein Besitzer hat viele Tiere – das passt: An owner has many animals – that does not fit into one column.
Der Fremdschlüssel steht auf der n-Seite: The foreign key is on the n side.
Wie verbindest du Tiere mit ihren Besitz: How do you join animals with their owners?
id = id ist Zufall. Verbunden wird der F: id = id is chance. The foreign key is joined with the id.

Lösung: SELECT tiere.name, arten.name, b: Solution: SELECT tiere.name, arten.name, besitzer.vorname FROM tiere JOIN arten ON tiere.art_id = arten.id JOIN besitzer ON tiere.besitzer_id = besitzer.id WHERE tiere.sucht = 'Gesangspartner'

Eine Zwischentabelle, z. B. bestellposit: A linking table, e.g. bestellpositionen with bestellung_id and produkt_id
